entities.description: A person is sitting cross-legged on a gray fabric couch, wearing a light purple satin pajama set with white piping and buttons. The couch has a textured, woven appearance and is adorned with a beige pillow on the right side.

clothing.top: light purple satin pajama shirt with white piping and buttons
clothing.bottoms: light purple satin pajama pants with white piping

entities.description: A young woman with curly dark brown hair and round wire-rimmed glasses sits cross-legged on a grey sofa, wearing a shiny lavender satin pajama set with white piping and a drawstring waist. She has a neutral expression and is looking directly at the camera with her hands resting on her legs.

clothing.details: white piping, button-down shirt, drawstring pants

entities.description: A square, beige throw pillow with a subtle, textured geometric pattern rests against a gray sofa backrest. In the lower left corner, a portion of a shiny, lavender-colored object, possibly a balloon or inflatable, is visible.
